items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: And he let -- he played a set and he let Buddy get up in the band. ... And Chick called a set and we throwed a set on Buddy, man, and he played.

ctx.x: Very few. Very few could sit in that band.
See, in the Savoy, wasn't no place for nobody to sit in unless you were great like Buddy Rich, or somebody like Gene Krupa Cooper, or somebody.
